text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Ingress API gateway (eu-west/edge-mux) reporting elevated 502/504 error rate, 15% error ratio over the last 2m, spike started ~3612345600. Page triggered for oncall_lee.
oncall_lee: Acknowledged. Jumping in. Any hit to customer-facing APIs?
sre_riley: Seeing 502 bursts on /v1/generate and /v1/embed from edge-mux. Quick grep of logs shows upstream 502s from ingress -> apigw-proxy pool. Sample: `GET /v1/generate 502 "upstream response code 502"`
eng_nina: Triage: looks regional — eu-west edge nodes at 3/10 healthy for mux backends, cpu nice but connection resets. Could be connection pool exhaustion or upstream short-lived overload.
pm_claire: CS asking for impact numbers — Jamal can you quantify customer hits?
cs_jamal: Early telemetry: ~18% of requests to hosted API failing with 502/504 for EU customers, ~4% increase in support tickets. Major customers on Dedicated not affected so far.
ops_bot: Runbook: if >10% errors, enable circuit breaker on edge-mux to 85% healthy threshold and shift 30% traffic to eu-central fallback.
sre_riley: I can toggle circuit breaker and start a gradual traffic shift. Doing it now.
eng_nina: FYI, recent deploy to apigw-proxy eu-west ~2h ago. Rollback candidate ready.
oncall_lee: Please run mitigation first (circuit-breaker + traffic shift). Avoid rollback until we confirm root cause.
sre_riley: Executing:
```
# set CB to 85% healthy, shift 30% to eu-central
kubectl -n ingress set env deploy/edge-mux CIRCUIT_BREAKER=85
kubectl -n ingress annotate svc/traffic-router shift-percent=30
```
(small delay...)
sre_riley: Applied. Metrics: error ratio dropped from 18% -> 9% within 90s. P50 latency stable.
eng_nina: Good. Gathering proxy logs for connection resets. Posting tail of proxy logs: 
```
apigw-proxy[pid] ERROR upstream reset: "recv(): Connection reset by peer" pool=proxy-124
apigw-proxy[pid] WARN connection_pool: reached max_conns=200
```
pm_claire: Jamal — update to customers: brief message that we're mitigating an edge gateway issue and will follow up.
cs_jamal: Sending note to affected customers now.
incident-bot: Handoff: oncall_lee -> oncall_ryan at 3612345900 (20m).
eng_nina: Hypothesis: recent connection pool default reduced by infra change in apigw-proxy config. If so, rolling restart with increased pool limit should clear.
sre_riley: I can do a controlled restart of apigw-proxy pods in eu-west with new env: MAX_CONNS=400. Will patch and restart one pod at a time.
oncall_lee: Go for it. Watch for reload spikes.
sre_riley: Patch applied and restarted pod-1. Observed immediate drop in connection reset logs. Error ratio now 3.2%. Traffic shift reduced further to 10% overall.
ops_bot: Telemetry check: 1m error rate 3.2%, 5m error rate trending down. No SLO breaches at account-level yet.
pm_claire: Note for PMs: no major customer-visible downtime; degraded errors for a small subset for ~18 minutes peak. We'll prepare a brief incident update.
eng_nina: Rolling restarts complete across eu-west cluster. Configuration change: MAX_CONNS=400, keepalive timeout extended. Recommend backfill to prod template.
cs_jamal: Customers updated: they reported recovery. Only 2 escalations opened, both acknowledged.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place, monitoring for 30m. Handoff complete to oncall_ryan.
oncall_lee: Leaving a short runbook note in the incident ticket. Action items: 1) Fix apigw-proxy config template (Nina). 2) Add alert to detect rising connection_reset rate (Riley). 3) Postmortem & customer timeline (Claire).
eng_nina: Will open PR for template change and include perf test for connection pool under surge.
sre_riley: I'll add a kpi for upstream reset rate and alert threshold.
pm_claire: I'll draft the customer timeline and postmortem outline.
cs_jamal: I'll follow up with the two affected customers and close their tickets after confirmation.
oncall_ryan: Took over. Monitoring looks stable. Marking incident as under control.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Resolved: Root cause likely connection pool exhaustion on apigw-proxy after a config regression during a deploy. Final error window ~12 minutes, peak 18% 502/504 ratio. Postmortem required.
pm_claire: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule the postmortem meeting for tomorrow.
eng_nina: Adding logs + grafana links to the incident ticket.
sre_riley: Closing thread here, will add alert PR link when done.
cs_jamal: Thanks — customer comms draft posted.
__notes: This thread is synthetically authored to reflect a short, realistic Slack incident triage flow: incident bot, on-call ack, quick triage/logs, mitigation (circuit breaker + traffic shift + restart), handoff, resolution, and action items. Messages are intentionally terse and include commands/log snippets as in real Slack threads.
